title: Slow improvement continues for the Western Slope
snippet: 500 millibar winds are transporting heavier smoke in the northwestern United States mostly to the north of Colorado. Image courtesy of the NOAA Storm Prediction Center The upper level winds over the western United States continue to shift as an upper level high pressure system builds over the desert southwest. The result is less smoke moving into western Colorado from fires to the west and northwest. All air quality advisories west of the Continental Divide will be allowed to expire at 9am…
